II." with an italic summary of its contents follows, then a paragraph and an italic quotation. Catchword "Atqui" at lower right. Two small notes in the left margin.

main_text.p: mini ad me. Nam si quis Christum assimilet gallinæ & Hierofolymitanos pullis infcienter se vulturibus exponentibus, & nolentibus contra matris suæ tenellum deliderium alis circum-volvi & protegi, is Christum Deum faciat non Deum. 2. Sit (quoties volui,) idem quod, (quoties decrevi,) tum decreta Dei cæterorum æterna indies iterari & reiterari, quoties prophetæ prædicabant, necesse foret, quod est absurdum. Prov. 1. Vocavi & renui-stis, non decrevi ut veniretis: nam illa vocatio reiteratur per multos annos in competis[?], in foris, at decretum Dei unicum & æternum est, ideoque vocavi idem est, quod verbo invitavi & testatum feci, mihi complacere vestram obedientiam, ne iota habet de Dei decreto.
main_text.head: CAP. II.

head.i: Solvitur illud, quod unusquisque tenetur credere, id est verum &c. 2. Quomodo Deum fidem exigat a reprobis. 3. De promissis Euangelij.

main_text.p: NOn parum lucis huic disputationi fænera-tur solutio illius objectionis, quam solam potentem esse noftram sententiam convellere dixit Arminius satis pro suo more Thrafonice. Ea hæc est.Antiperk.p. 735.

p.i: Quod unusquisque tenetur credere, id est verum.

page.notes: The left margin carries "Antiperk." and "p. 735." (the second is read as "p. 735."). The running head abbreviation "Unusq̃" is read as Unusquisque with a suspension mark, uncertain. "competis" is doubtful (possibly compitis). The catchword "Atqui" is set at lower right below the text; it is also reproduced once in main_text as a foot line, which is a transcription error to be removed by the assembler if the catchword element is used. Greek and Hebrew: none on this page.
